description: Implementation of a QUIC server class (QuicServer) handling socket creation, event processing, and dispatching for QUIC protocol communications.

classes.name: QuicServer
classes.description: A server class implementing QUIC protocol handling, socket management, and event dispatching.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes server configurations, including flow control windows and default crypto config.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndListen
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket, binds it to an address, and starts listening for incoming packets.

methods.name: CreateWriter
methods.description: Creates a packet writer for the given socket file descriptor.

methods.name: CreateQuicDispatcher
methods.description: Creates and returns a new dispatcher for handling QUIC connections.

methods.name: CreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates and returns a new event loop instance.

methods.name: HandleEventsForever
methods.description: Runs the event loop indefinitely to handle socket events.

methods.name: WaitForEvents
methods.description: Runs the event loop once with a timeout.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the server, closing sockets and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: OnSocketEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events such as readability and writability, processing incoming packets and managing dispatcher state.
